Subject: 20% off your next trail kit — pack and socks, together
Preview: Cascade 45L + Trailwool Socks. 20% off through Sunday.
Body: If you've got a trip coming up — a long weekend, a section hike, anything that keeps you out more than one night — this is a practical time to fill a gap in your kit.

Through Sunday, the Northbay Cascade 45L Trekking Pack (NB-TRK-01) and Trailwool Sock 3-Pack (NB-SOK-11) are 20% off when bought together as a trail bundle.

The Cascade 45L holds up to 45 liters and weighs 1.4 kg. The internal frame keeps the load close to your back on uneven ground. The ripstop nylon shell is water-resistant — it handles light rain and trail splash, but it's not waterproof, so plan accordingly on multi-day trips in wet conditions.

The Trailwool Socks are a merino wool blend. Three pairs per pack. Merino manages moisture and odor reasonably well over consecutive days, which matters when your resupply options are limited.

No upsell here. Just two things that work well together on trail, at 20% off until Sunday.
